subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Charity Gala event on December 15th at the Grand Ballroom. This year's gala will be a night to remember with live music, gourmet dinner, charity auction, and more. Save the date and stay tuned for further details. We look forward to celebrating this special evening with all of you. Best regards, [Company Name] Events Team
